column3: “Earth” is rendered “dirt.”
“Offspring” is rendered “descendants,” and “sons of foreignness” as “foreigners.”
NASB supplies “for” and “another.”
NASB spells “Chenani.”
“From antiquity until perpetuity” is rendered “forever and ever.” “May people bless your glorious name” is rendered “O may Your glorious name be blessed.”
“The heavens of the heavens” is rendered “The heaven of heavens,” and “preserving alive” as “give life to.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Your words” is rendered “Your promise”; NASB supplies “him” and “it.”
“The sea of reeds” is rendered “the Red Sea.”
“Gave” is rendered “performed,” and “on” as “against.”
“Split open” is rendered “divided,” and “mighty waters” as “raging waters.”
“Walked in it” is rendered “were to go.”
“Upright judgments” is rendered “just ordinances,” and “laws of faithfulness” as “true laws.”
“Commanded” is rendered “laid down,” and “by the hand of” as “through.”
“Had lifted your hand” is rendered “swore.”
“They and our fathers” is rendered “they, our fathers,” and “stiffened their neck” as “became stubborn.”
The Hebrew reads “in their rebellion”; NASB reads “in Egypt,” as some manuscripts do. “A God of forgivenesses” is rendered “a God of forgiveness,” and “covenant loyalty” as “lovingkindness.”
NASB supplies “when.”
“In their daytime” is rendered “by day.”
“Spirit” is capitalized in NASB.
“Sustained” is rendered “provided for,” and “were not lacking” as “were not in want.”

The Hebrew reads “the land of Sihon and the land of the king of Heshbon”; NASB has “Sihon the king of Heshbon.” “Apportioned them to a corner” is rendered “allotted them to them as a boundary”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Children” is rendered “sons.”
“The children” is rendered “their sons,” and “according to their will” as “as they desired.”
“Fertile ground” is rendered “a fertile land,” and “luxuriated” as “reveled.”
“Warned” is rendered “admonished.”
“Opponents” is rendered “oppressors.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Warned” is rendered “admonished,” and “gave a stubborn shoulder” as “turned a stubborn shoulder.”
“Prolonged toward them” is rendered “bore with them,” and “warned” as “admonished.”
